title: Inheritance Tax account (IHT400)
text:
You must complete the form IHT400, as part of the probate or confirmation process if there’s Inheritance Tax to pay, or the deceased’s estate does not qualify as an ‘excepted estate’. You can use the notes and forms IHT401 to IHT436 to support you.

 Before you start

 Make sure your browser is up to date .

 You’ll need to fill in the form fully before you can print it. You cannot save a partly completed form so we suggest you gather all your information together before you begin to fill it in.

 The Inheritance Tax account (IHT400) form is interactive (one that you complete on screen) and you must use Adobe Reader to complete it.

 If the form does not open, contact online services support for more help .
